newsitem.title: INDONESIA: U.S. Levi Strauss launches Indonesian unit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Levi Strauss launches Indonesian unit.

text.p: Levi Strauss & Co, one of the world's largest apparel firms, said on Tuesday it had launched a wholly-owned Indonesian unit called PT Levi Strauss Indonesia.
The Indonesian company will manufacture, market and distribute Levi's jeans and casual apparel at the wholesale level, Levi Strauss said in a statement.
Levi Strauss Indonesia had assumed direct management of the Levi's brand in the country from its licensee, privately-owned PT Jay Gee Enterprises, effective from December 1, 1996, it said.
It said the apparel firm currently works with around 18 Indonesia-based garment contractors which provide the sewing, laundry and finishing facilities for its products.
The statement did not give further details.
